extra_actual.proposition_text: The occupier of a holding must ensure that in any twelve-month period, the total amount of nitrogen in organic manure spread on any given hectare of land on the holding does not exceed 250kg.

The occupier may exceed the 250kg nitrogen limit if organic manure is in the form of certified green compost or certified green/food compost, the nitrogen amount in such compost does not exceed specified limits, and no other form of organic

For certified green compost or green/food compost, the total amount of nitrogen spread on any given hectare must not exceed 500kg in any two-year period, whether spread as mulch or incorporated into the soil.
For orchard land, the total amount of nitrogen in certified green compost or green/food compost spread as mulch must not exceed 1,000kg per hectare in any four-year period.
For the purposes of the grassland exemption, the area of the holding does not include any land on which the occupier does not spread fertiliser or work the soil.
For the purposes of regulation 8, the total amount of nitrogen in organic manure is to be calculated by reference to the methods described in regulation 14.
The 250kg nitrogen limit does not apply to land covered by a greenhouse for the whole of the period concerned.
